conbody.p: Figure 44 is a scatter plot showing the Environmental Temperature in Celsius (°C) from the Environmental Temperature sensor.

ul.li: The scatter plot’s X-axis shows date and time.
The scatter plot’s Y-Axis shows the temperature in Celsius (°C).
